project:
packages:
  mina-core
  mina-cli

-- mori-schema-pin exports the canonical mori-schema commit and Dhall
-- integrity hashes that Mina.Mori.Catalog re-exports. The pinned SHA
-- must match the value expected in
-- mina-core/test/Mina/Mori/CatalogSpec.hs (the coupling smoke test).
source-repository-package
  type: git
  location: https://github.com/shinzui/mori
  tag: 7af02c55257abfab52644b9e129496a0efb70f6a
  subdir:
    mori-schema-pin

-- Baikai depends on the unreleased streamly 0.12 / streamly-core 0.4 pair
-- pinned at shinzui/streamly-project. Mirror Baikai's own cabal.project
-- pins so the dependency closure resolves identically on both sides.
source-repository-package
  type: git
  location: https://github.com/shinzui/streamly-project
  tag: f8e33b5600f5ddadc17ce5d9a8e45a16c09899cb
  subdir: streamly

source-repository-package
  type: git
  location: https://github.com/shinzui/streamly-project
  tag: f8e33b5600f5ddadc17ce5d9a8e45a16c09899cb
  subdir: streamly/core

-- The vendored streamly packages ship live tasty suites we do not want
-- pulled into `cabal test all`. Library only.
package streamly
  tests: False

package streamly-core
  tests: False

-- shikumi-trace pulls in shikumi-cache -> blake3 (EP-6 content-addressed cache
-- key). blake3 vendors SIMD C/asm whose non-x86 fallback still compiles x86
-- intrinsics (mmintrin.h), which fails under clang on aarch64-darwin. Mirror
-- shikumi's own cabal.project workaround: disable the SIMD flags so only the
-- portable pure-C path is built, and force the portable path on ARM (the
-- package never compiles blake3_neon.c yet references blake3_hash_many_neon).
package blake3
  flags: -avx512 -avx2 -sse41 -sse2
  ghc-options: -optc-DBLAKE3_USE_NEON=0

write-ghc-environment-files: never
